a.xlink:title: Imports a legacy case, which the user chooses, as a scene and opens it.
The messages of the last validation of the scene.
Asks whether to save unsaved changes. Returns false when the user cancels or the save fails.
Opens the scene folder or bundle at dir now. The scene stays as it was when this returns false.
True when wroteScene is set and no diagnostic is an error.
The path for a UTF-8 name. Text that cannot be converted as UTF-8 is read in the system code page,...
The content of passengers.json. A journey without an activity leaves the key out.
The scenario of a case that stores none: id "baseline", no incidents and no entrance delays.
True when a diagnostic has severity Error.
